title: Project inventory
objective: Inspect the repository structure and create a concise project inventory for VLA/world model workflow planning.
context: Before creating VLA/world model tasks, AI-A needs a safe project inventory. This task must not modify source code or launch robot scripts.
steps: List directories up to depth 2 while pruning .git, datasets, dataset, checkpoints, and rosbags.
Identify likely robot, VLA, world model, ROS, viewer, tool, log, and script components from filenames and safe directory names.
success_criteria: Major robot/VLA/world model related files are identified.
Unknowns and next inspection targets are listed.
No robot motion script is executed.
stop_conditions: A command attempts to read secrets.
A command attempts to launch robot motion.
A command attempts to modify source code.
A command attempts to access datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
